title: Welsh independence
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Welsh independence", at revision 1382610780, opens: "Welsh independence is a political movement advocating for Wales to become a sovereign state, independent from the United Kingdom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3304490, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "political ideal that would see Wales secede from the United Kingdom and become an independent sovereign state". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
